{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module EmailService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Char (toLower)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (BlockCipher (..), Cipher (..), AEADMode (AEAD_GCM), AuthTag (..))
import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable (..))
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA

-- Load the 32-byte (256-bit) storage key from the environment.
-- Keys must NEVER be hard-coded in source. Expected as base64 in EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY.
loadStorageKey :: IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
loadStorageKey = do
  mval <- lookupEnv "EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY"
  case mval of
    Nothing -> return (Left "EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY not set")
    Just v  -> case B64.decode (C8.pack v) of
      Left e   -> return (Left ("Invalid EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY encoding: " ++ e))
      Right kb
        | BS.length kb == 32 -> return (Right kb)
        | otherwise          -> return (Left "EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY must be 32 bytes (base64)")

initCipher :: BS.ByteString -> Either String AES256
initCipher key = case cipherInit key of
  CryptoPassed c -> Right c
  CryptoFailed e -> Left (show e)

-- Authenticated encryption for storage using AES-256-GCM.
-- Output layout (base64-encoded): nonce (12 bytes) || tag (16 bytes) || ciphertext.
encryptForStorage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BS.ByteString)
encryptForStorage key plaintext =
  case initCipher key of
    Left e -> return (Left e)
    Right cipher -> do
      nonceBytes <- getRandomBytes 12 :: IO BS.ByteString
      case aeadInit AEAD_GCM cipher nonceBytes of
        CryptoFailed e -> return (Left (show e))
        CryptoPassed aead ->
          let (ct, aeadFinal) = aeadEncrypt aead plaintext
              AuthTag tag = aeadFinalize aeadFinal 16
              tagBytes = BS.pack (BA.unpack tag)
              combined = nonceBytes `BS.append` tagBytes `BS.append` ct
          in return (Right (B64.encode combined))

decryptFromStorage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Either String BS.ByteString
decryptFromStorage key ciphertext = do
  combined <- B64.decode ciphertext
  if BS.length combined < 28
    then Left "Ciphertext too short"
    else do
      let nonceBytes = BS.take 12 combined
          tagBytes   = BS.take 16 (BS.drop 12 combined)
          ct         = BS.drop 28 combined
      cipher <- initCipher key
      case aeadInit AEAD_GCM cipher nonceBytes of
        CryptoFailed e -> Left (show e)
        CryptoPassed aead ->
          let (pt, aeadFinal) = aeadDecrypt aead ct
              expectedTag = AuthTag (BA.convert tagBytes)
          in if aeadFinalize aeadFinal 16 == expectedTag
             then Right pt
             else Left "Authentication tag mismatch (tampering detected)"

-- Header injection check: looks for CRLF sequences
-- Uses a normalized form to detect injection attempts
data SanitizeResult = Clean T.Text | Rejected String

-- Normalize text by handling encoded forms before checking
normalizeForCheck :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString
normalizeForCheck input =
  let -- Decode any percent-encoded sequences in the input
      decoded = percentDecode (TE.encodeUtf8 input)
      -- Convert to lowercase for consistent checking
      lowered = C8.map toLower decoded
  in lowered

percentDecode :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
percentDecode bs
  | BS.null bs = BS.empty
  | otherwise =
      let (before, after) = C8.break (== '%') bs
      in if BS.null after
         then before
         else if BS.length after >= 3
              then let hexPart = BS.take 2 (BS.drop 1 after)
                       rest = BS.drop 3 after
                       decoded = decodeHexByte hexPart
                   in case decoded of
                        Just b  -> before `BS.append` BS.singleton b `BS.append` percentDecode rest
                        Nothing -> before `BS.append` BS.singleton 0x25 `BS.append` percentDecode (BS.drop 1 after)
              else before `BS.append` after

decodeHexByte :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe Word8
decodeHexByte bs
  | BS.length bs /= 2 = Nothing
  | otherwise =
      let [h, l] = BS.unpack bs
          high = hexVal h
          low = hexVal l
      in case (high, low) of
           (Just hv, Just lv) -> Just (hv * 16 + lv)
           _ -> Nothing

hexVal :: Word8 -> Maybe Word8
hexVal w
  | w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39 = Just (w - 0x30)
  | w >= 0x41 && w <= 0x46 = Just (w - 0x41 + 10)
  | w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x66 = Just (w - 0x61 + 10)
  | otherwise = Nothing

-- Check for dangerous bytes in the FINAL encoded form
containsDangerousBytes :: BS.ByteString -> Bool
containsDangerousBytes bs =
  BS.any (\w -> w == 0x0D || w == 0x0A) bs

-- The sanitization pipeline - checks the ENCODED output form
sanitizeEmailHeader :: T.Text -> SanitizeResult
sanitizeEmailHeader input =
  let encoded = TE.encodeUtf8 input
  in if containsDangerousBytes encoded
     then Rejected "Header injection detected: CR or LF byte found"
     else Clean input

-- Compose email with headers
data Email = Email
  { emailFrom    :: T.Text
  , emailTo      :: T.Text
  , emailSubject :: T.Text
  , emailBody    :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Build raw email for sending via SMTP
buildRawEmail :: Email -> Either String BS.ByteString
buildRawEmail email = do
  from <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailFrom email) of
            Clean t -> Right t
            Rejected e -> Left e
  to <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailTo email) of
          Clean t -> Right t
          Rejected e -> Left e
  subject <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailSubject email) of
               Clean t -> Right t
               Rejected e -> Left e
  let rawEmail = T.concat
        [ "From: ", from, "\r\n"
        , "To: ", to, "\r\n"
        , "Subject: ", subject, "\r\n"
        , "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n"
        , "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n"
        , "\r\n"
        , emailBody email
        ]
  return $ TE.encodeUtf8 rawEmail

-- Store email in encrypted form and return for sending
processEmail :: BS.ByteString -> Email -> IO (Either String (BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString))
processEmail key email =
  case buildRawEmail email of
    Left e -> return (Left e)
    Right raw -> do
      encResult <- encryptForStorage key raw
      case encResult of
        Left e       -> return (Left e)
        Right stored -> return (Right (raw, stored))

-- Entry point for the service
handleSendRequest :: T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO (Either String (BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString))
handleSendRequest from to subject body = do
  keyResult <- loadStorageKey
  case keyResult of
    Left e    -> return (Left e)
    Right key ->
      let email = Email from to subject body
      in processEmail key email
